description.value:
You have spent your life as a sorcerer being part of a clan. You are well-versed in manipulating Cursed Energy, and you also possess great mastery over your innate technique. You are not necessarily well-treated or even particularly well-liked within your clan.
Feat: Pick one Innate Technique feat
Skill Proficiencies: Insight, History
Equipment: A clan symbol (a gift to you as part of your clan), a technique manual, formal clothing, a set of common clothes, and a wallet containing $1,500.
Feature: Family Ties
As a Clan Sorcerer, you command the respect of those in Sorcery, and you are an effective sorcerer. You and your companions can expect to receive help from people who like your family.

tH8JmRo0Meu4CEtR.title: Mindset
tH8JmRo0Meu4CEtR.hint: Choose the mindset that drives your sorcery (it replaces Inspiration).

description.value:
You are someone who was raised with a notion of greatness about you. Always placed on a pedestal above your peers for your intelligence, skills, or natural-born ability. Before coming to Jujutsu Tech, you had such an aptitude for success that strangers, parents, and teachers alike all placed you in a league of your own. You have proven that to be the case up until now and will likely continue to prove it moving forward. Whether you choose to continue the path assumed you would, or shift focus is your own choice. You have both good and bad experiences with this assumption of genius about you. Memories like these are something you may cherish or despise, but you are a Genius through and through.
Feat: Pick one Skill feat
Skill Proficiencies: Arcana, Athletics
Equipment: One letter of recommendation passed down to you from someone of importance, 1 Blank Scroll, A Wallet Containing $1,000.
Feature: Meeting Expectations
You always seem to rise to the expectations of others during a challenge. When confronted with a difficult situation, you seem to gain insight after just one attempt, passing or failing it. This insight is a hint at how this particular challenge does or doesn’t work, that others around you may not understand.

Z5aNev5XP59BWlrl.hint: Choose the mindset that drives your sorcery (it replaces Inspiration).

description.value:
You were someone who always had to prove to themselves and others that you are worth your weight and space. You always had to work twice as hard and twice as long to see results, but the results are beginning to show. You never had the natural talent of your peers, no, you had peerless determination and persistence to push through all of the challenges you were faced with to make it to this point, while also looking forward to the next day to get better. You have reached a level of discipline that your peers can’t imagine, so you can keep up your training on your own time while not lagging when you do decide to take a break.
Feat: Pick one Physical Feat
Skill Proficiencies: Athletics, Acrobatics
Equipment: Set of Body weights that weigh 50+ pounds. For each part of your body, 3 Books containing training strategies, Training Gi, and a Wallet containing $1,000.
Feature: Focus and Grit
You have trained yourself in such a way that you have absorbed multiple tomes of knowledge in whatever you worked your butt off to excel in. You are able to quickly bond with people who have the same drive and determination as you and even garner immediate audiences and conversations with those people. You are also able to reference and call out different books, strategies, and texts to catch the attention of those who have read those texts or follow those strategies.

description.value:
Whether you are a first generation sorcerer born to a normal family or someone who split away from the jujutsu world to become an illegal curse user, you have learned to survive without the backing of a clan or the approval of the higher-ups. The world is vast beyond the walls of the schools and great, and not every sorcerer chooses, or is allowed, to live under their watchful eyes. Some Freelancers are wanderers, exorcising curses in forgotten villages or protecting those too poor to afford official aid. Others drift into the underbelly of the jujutsu world, selling techniques, cursed tools, or information to whoever can pay. Without the structure of the clans or the bureaucracy of the schools, you rely on your own wit and adaptability. You make connections where you can, trust few, and keep your head down when the higher-ups come sniffing around.
Feat: Pick one Cursed Energy Feat
Skill Proficiency: Perception, Deception
Tool Proficiency: Thieves Tools or Disguise Kit
Equipment: Set of travelers clothes for streetwear, a notebook of jobs, a burner cellphone, forgery kit or thieves tools, a wallet containing $2,000.

Feature: Independent Network

Years spent working outside official channels have given you access to an informal web of contacts; smugglers, minor sorcerers, black-market exorcists, and ordinary citizens who owe you a favor. You can usually find information, shelter, or supplies through this network when operating in a city or settlement, even if it’s unofficial or risky.
You can also identify whether a community is under the influence of jujutsu authorities or illegal curse activity within a few hours of arriving, letting you decide which side to approach or avoid first.

LpWoZGVJwtsh9w1V.hint: Choose the mindset that drives your sorcery (it replaces Inspiration).

description.value:
Windows are the eyes and ears of the jujutsu society, monitoring spiritual activity, identifying incidents, and supporting exorcists in the field. Most Windows are civilians with just enough cursed energy to see curses, while others may be failed sorcerers who could not handle field assignments and now handle deploying veils. Though you may initially lack the power to destroy curses yourself, your vigilance and courage allow others to act before it’s too late.
Feat: Pick one Barrier Feat
Skill Proficiency: Persuasion, Investigation
Tool Proficiency: Calligrapher’s Tools
Equipment: set of fine clothes for work, a pair of cursed glasses that let you see curses, calligrapher’s tools, a wallet with $1,000 dollars.

Feature: In the System

You are recognized by the jujutsu community as a trained observer. You know how to file reports, contact field agents, and navigate the bureaucratic maze between exorcists, schools, and local authorities. You can usually gain an audience with a jujutsu operative or access to minor restricted areas where supernatural activity is being investigated. When you’re in a new area, you can quickly locate the nearest contact point, safe zone, or local informant tied to curse management. Those in the know may not trust you, but they’ll usually hear you out before turning you away.

jwGQpw0Ohqiwajg2.title: Mindset
jwGQpw0Ohqiwajg2.hint: Choose the mindset that drives your sorcery (it replaces Inspiration).

description.value: In sorcery your mindset affects your power. These are represented as an alternative to the inspiration system.
Amongst heaven and earth, you alone are the honored one. Your needs are all that matter. If you use your inspiration, you can choose to deal maximum damage.
In the greater schemes of sorcery you are a part of the greater whole. If you use your inspiration, you cure all conditions and minor injuries and regain 1/4 of your hit points.
This is a job, like all others you clock in, clock out. If you use your inspiration, you can choose to gain the effects of Haste for 1 minute as the deadline approaches.
There are two reasons for your actions, spite and hatred. If you use your inspiration you pick one creature, and that creature becomes vulnerable to your attacks for 1 turn.

Getting lost in your passion and the rush of success, this is what you live for. If you use your inspiration, for the next minute when you hit a creature or another creature damages you, gain a stackable +1 to attack and damage rolls.

Rightfulness is your modus operandi. If you use your inspiration you deem up to 5 creatures villains, you and your allies gain advantage on attacks against them for 1 minute, and you can stay up at 1 hit point once as you refuse to fall before the villain.

The bells of the Gion monastery in India echo with the warning that all things are impermanent. The blossoms of the sala trees teach us through their hues that what flourishes must fade. However! We are the exception! If you use your inspiration, you can choose an ally as a fellow exception to share hit points with you in a unified pool for 1 hour.
If you are going down, it won't be without a fight. If you use your inspiration you regain 1/2 your cursed energy.

The hatred, the anger, the jealousy, the envy, the bonds that chain you down. You have decided to leave those all behind with your overwhelming intensity. If you use your inspiration, you gain an extra bonus action or reaction each turn for 1 minute.

Support isn’t about glory. It’s about making sure everyone gets home. You are the backbone of coordination. When you use your inspiration, you and up to two allies gain temporary hit points equal to twice your level + your proficiency bonus.

People may not care for your unconventional nature, but who cares? Humans are gross! When you use your inspiration, you cannot have disadvantage on any rolls and others cannot have advantage against you for the next minute.

You fight with pure sincerity, even when outmatched. When you use your inspiration, whenever you make an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can choose to treat the roll as a 10 for the next minute.

You are pride, stubbornness, and conviction incarnate. When you would be reduced to 0 hit points, you can use your inspiration to defy death and instead fall to 1/6 your hit point maximum (rounded up) and immediately take one action.

You’ve learned that silence can speak louder than rage.
When you use your inspiration you automatically succeed on Concentration checks and gain +5 to ability checks based on communication (like Persuasion or Intimidation) for 1 minute.

Your name carries weight, and with it, duty. You fight for the principles that define you. When you use your inspiration, for the next minute if an ally within 10 feet is damaged, you can choose to interpose yourself and force the attack to target you and take half damage, as you uphold your honor by protecting those under your watch.
You were cast out, reviled, and forgotten. Yet none can deny your power. When you use your inspiration, all creatures within 30 ft of you are frightened for the next minute.
